en.s: The Battle of Tricamarum took place on 15 December 533 between the armies of the Byzantine Empire, under Belisarius, and the Vandal Kingdom, commanded by King Gelimer and his brother Tzazo. Following the Byzantine victory at the Battle of Ad Decimum in September 533, Belisarius captured Carthage and prepared to face the remaining Vandal forces led by King Gelimer.

en.s: Pope Sergius I (c. 650 – 8 September 701) was the bishop of Rome from 15 December 687 to his death on 8 September 701, and is revered as a saint by the Roman Catholic Church. en.t: Constantine VIII (depicted) became the sole Byzantine emperor, 63 years after being crowned co-emperor
en.s: Constantine VIII (Greek: Κωνσταντῖνος, romanized: Kōnstantīnos; 960 – 11/12 November 1028) was de jure Byzantine emperor from 962 until his death. He was the younger son of Emperor Romanos II and Empress Theophano. He was nominal co-emperor from 962, successively with his father; his stepfather, Nikephoros II Phokas; his uncle, John I Tzimiskes; and his brother, Basil II. Basil's death in 1025 left Constantine as the sole emperor.

zh.t: 君士坦丁八世（图中人物）成为拜占庭帝国唯一皇帝，距加冕为共治皇帝已有63年
zh.s: 君士坦丁八世（希腊语：Κωνσταντῖνος，转写：Kōnstantīnos；960年—1028年11月11日或12日）自962年起依法为拜占庭皇帝，直至去世。他是罗曼努斯二世和狄奥法诺皇后的次子。自962年起，他名义上担任共治皇帝，先后与父亲、继父尼基弗鲁斯二世·福卡斯、叔父约翰一世·齐米斯基斯以及兄长巴西尔二世共同执政。1025年巴西尔去世后，君士坦丁成为唯一皇帝。

en.s: The Battle of Baia (Romanian: Bătălia de la Baia) was fought on 15 December 1467 between the Moldavian Prince, Stephen the Great and Hungarian King, Matthias Corvinus. The battle was the last Hungarian attempt to subdue the independent Moldavia, as previous attempts had ended in failure. Corvinus invaded Moldavia as a consequence of Stephen's annexation of Chilia—a fortress and harbour at the coast of the Black Sea, which at the time was controlled by Hungarian and Wallachian forces, though it had belonged to Moldavia centuries earlier. The conflict ended with a defeat for the Hungarians.

zh.s: 1467年12月15日，摩尔达维亚公爵斯特凡大公与匈牙利国王马加什一世在巴亚交战。这是匈牙利最后一次试图征服独立的摩尔达维亚，此前的尝试均告失败。马加什一世入侵摩尔达维亚，是因为斯特凡吞并了基利亚要塞及港口。基利亚位于黑海沿岸，当时由匈牙利和瓦拉几亚军队控制，但几个世纪前曾属于摩尔达维亚。战役以匈牙利军队战败告终。

en.s: The Battle of Kesselsdorf was fought on 15 December 1745, between the Kingdom of Prussia and the combined forces of the Archduchy of Austria and the Electorate of Saxony during the part of the War of the Austrian Succession known as the Second Silesian War. en.t: The United States Bill of Rights becomes law when ratified by the Virginia General Assembly
en.s: The United States Bill of Rights comprises the first ten amendments to the United States Constitution. It was proposed following the often bitter 1787–88 debate over the ratification of the Constitution and written to address the objections raised by Anti-Federalists. The amendments of the Bill of Rights add to the Constitution specific guarantees of personal freedoms, such as freedom of speech, the right to publish, practice religion, possess firearms, to assemble, and other natural and legal rights.

en.s: The Battle of Ocheesee took place on a bluff overlooking the Apalachicola River, in northwest Spanish Florida, beginning in December of 1817. The shooting part of the battle lasted almost a week, but the engagement lasted "weeks" and was "the longest sustained engagement of the Seminole Wars". The name comes from the bluffs that overlook the river, from which one party of marksmen waged their attack. Today the land is in Torreya State Park. On December 15, 1817, Red Stick Creek Indians fired from both sides of the river simultaneously on ships carrying supplies upriver to Fort Gaines, Fort Scott, and Fort Hughes, the latter of which was simultaneously attacked.

zh.s: 1817年12月，西班牙佛罗里达西北部阿巴拉奇科拉河旁的高崖地区爆发奥奇西战役。交火持续了近一周，整个交战则延续数周，是塞米诺尔战争中持续时间最长的一次。战役名称来自俯瞰河面的高崖，一方枪手曾从那里发起攻击；如今该地区属于托雷亚州立公园。1817年12月15日，红棍派克里克人从河流两岸同时向驶往上游、为盖恩斯堡、斯科特堡和休斯堡运送补给的船只开火，其中休斯堡也在同一时间遭到攻击。

en.s: The 1836 U.S. Patent Office fire was the first of two major fires the U.S. Patent Office has had in its history. It occurred in Blodget's Hotel building, Washington on December 15, 1836. en.s: The Battle of Nashville was a two-day battle in the Franklin-Nashville Campaign that represented the end of large-scale fighting west of the coastal states in the American Civil War. It was fought at Nashville, Tennessee, on December 15–16, 1864, between the Confederate Army of Tennessee under Lieutenant General John Bell Hood and Federal forces under Major General George H. en.t: The short-lived Republic of Ezo is proclaimed in the Ezo area of Japan. It is the first attempt to establish a democracy in Japan

en.s: The British Indian Army Lushai Expedition of 1871 to 1872 was a punitive incursion under the command of Generals Brownlow and Bourchier. The objectives of the expedition were to rescue British subjects who had been captured by the Lushais in raids into Assam—including a six-year-old girl called Mary Winchester—and to convince the hill tribes of the region that they had nothing to gain and everything to lose by placing themselves in a hostile position towards the British Government.

en.t: Sixteen-year-old telegraphist Ella Stewart keys and sends the first telegraphed message from Arizona Territory at the Deseret Telegraph Company office in Pipe Spring
en.s: Eliza Luella "Ella" Stewart Udall (May 21, 1855 – May 28, 1937) was an American telegraphist and entrepreneur. Recruited by Brigham Young in 1870 and stationed at the Deseret Telegraph Company office in Pipe Spring in 1871, Udall was the first telegraph operator in Arizona Territory. A daughter of Mormon pioneers Margery Wilkerson Stewart and Levi Stewart, Udall was a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints her entire life.

en.s: The Lewisham by-election, 1903 was a by-election held on 15 December 1903 for the British House of Commons constituency of Lewisham. The by-election was triggered by the death of the serving Conservative Party Member of Parliament (MP), John Penn. The Unionist candidate was Major Edward Coates. The Liberal Party candidate was James William Cleland. As with the Dulwich by-election held on the same day, the main issue was tariff reform and Joseph Chamberlain's proposals for Imperial Preference. A factor which made the result of the by election difficult to predict was that the seat had not been contested since 1892 and in that time the population had doubled in size.

en.t: Italo Marchiony receives a U.S. patent for an ice-cream cup mold
en.s: On December 15, 1903, Italo Marchiony of New York received U.S. Patent No. 746,971 for a mold used to make edible ice-cream cups. The patent described hinged blocks that shaped the cups and made them easier to remove after cooking. It covered the molding apparatus; it does not establish that Marchiony invented every form of ice-cream cone on that day.
en.n: The patent was issued December 15, 1903; the invention was a mold for edible ice-cream cups.

en.s: The Serbian campaign of 1914 was a significant military operation during World War I. It marked the first major confrontation between the Central Powers, primarily Austria-Hungary, and the Allied Powers, led by the Kingdom of Serbia. The campaign started on 28 July 1914, when Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia and bombarded Belgrade. On 12 August, the Austro-Hungarian forces, led by General Oskar Potiorek, launched their first offensive into Serbia.

en.s: The anarchist insurrection of December 1933 was an attempted revolution by Spanish anarchists, in response to the victory of the right-wing in the 1933 Spanish general election. en.s: The New Britain campaign was a World War II campaign fought between Allied and Imperial Japanese forces. The campaign was initiated by the Allies in late 1943 as part of a major offensive which aimed to neutralise the important Japanese base at Rabaul, the capital of New Britain, and was conducted in two phases between December 1943 and the end of the war in August 1945.

zh.s: 新不列颠战役是第二次世界大战期间盟军与日本帝国军队之间的一场战役。盟军于1943年末发起行动，旨在削弱日本在新不列颠首府拉包尔的重要基地。战役分两个阶段进行，从1943年12月持续至1945年8月战争结束。

en.s: The Shinto Directive was an order issued in 1945 to the Japanese government by Occupation authorities to abolish state support for the Shinto religion. This unofficial "State Shinto" was thought by Allies to have been a major contributor to Japan's nationalistic and militant culture that led to World War II. The purpose of the directive was ostensibly based in ideas of freedom of religion and separation of church and state.

zh.s: 神道指令是占领当局于1945年向日本政府发布的命令，要求取消国家对神道教的支持。盟军认为，这种非正式的“国家神道”助长了日本的民族主义和军国主义文化，并推动日本走向二战。该指令表面上以宗教自由和政教分离为依据。

en.s: The first election to the Representative Assembly of French India (French: Assemblée Représentative des Indes Françaises) was held on 15 December 1946 to constitute the First Representative Assembly of French India. The election included Pondichéry (with 22 seats), Karaikal (12 seats), Chandernagor (5 seats), Mahé (3 seats) and Yanaon (2 seats). The election was won by the National Democratic Front of Deiva Zivarattinam, that won 30 out of 44 seats.

zh.s: 1946年12月15日，法属印度举行首次代表议会选举，成立第一届代表议会。选举涵盖本地治里（22席）、卡赖卡尔（12席）、钱德讷格尔（5席）、马埃（3席）和亚南（2席）。德伊瓦·齐瓦拉蒂南所属的国家民主阵线获胜，在44席中赢得30席。

en.t: U.S.-backed Iranian troops brought an end to the Iran crisis when they marched on the breakaway Republic of Mahabad and recaptured the territory
en.s: The Iran crisis of 1946, also known as the Azerbaijan crisis (Persian: غائلهٔ آذربایجان, romanized: Qā'ele-ye Āzarbāyejān) in Iranian sources, was one of the first crises during the aftermath of World War II, sparked by the refusal of Joseph Stalin's Soviet Union to relinquish occupied Iranian territory despite repeated assurances. The end of World War II should have resulted in the end of the Allied joint occupation of Iran.

zh.t: 美国支持的伊朗军队进军分离主义的马哈巴德共和国并收复该地区，结束伊朗危机
zh.s: 1946年伊朗危机又称阿塞拜疆危机（伊朗语：غائلهٔ آذربایجان，罗马化：Qā'ele-ye Āzarbāyejān），是第二次世界大战结束后最早发生的危机之一。约瑟夫·斯大林领导的苏联在多次保证后仍拒绝撤出其占领的伊朗领土，由此引发危机。二战结束后，盟军本应终止对伊朗的联合占领。

en.s: Elections were held in Indonesia on 15 December 1955 to elect all 514 members of the Constitutional Assembly. The Provisional Constitution of 1950 had provided for the establishment of an elected body to draw up a permanent constitution following Indonesia's independence from the Netherlands. In April 1953, the House of Representatives passed the election bill.

zh.t: 1955年印度尼西亚制宪议会选举
zh.s: 1955年12月15日，印度尼西亚举行选举，选出制宪议会全部514名成员。1950年临时宪法规定，应选举产生一个机构，为印尼脱离荷兰独立后起草永久宪法。1953年4月，众议院通过了选举法案。

en.s: 1960 Nepal coup d'état was a coup d'état led by King Mahendra on 15 December 1960. The same day, he dismissed the cabinet of B.P. Koirala and imprisoned Koirala. On 13 April 1961, Mahendra made a televised appearance, in which he introduced Panchayat, a partyless political system.

zh.s: 1960年12月15日，马亨德拉国王发动政变，解散比·普·柯伊拉腊内阁并将其逮捕。1961年4月13日，马亨德拉通过电视讲话介绍无政党的潘查亚特制度。

en.s: The Eichmann trial was the 1961 trial of major Holocaust perpetrator Adolf Eichmann, who was captured in Argentina by Israeli agents and taken to Israel to stand trial. Eichmann was a senior Nazi party member and served at the rank of Obersturmbannführer in the SS, and was primarily responsible for the implementation of the Final Solution.
en.n: Eichmann trial: Adolf Eichmann is sentenced to death after being found guilty by an Israeli court of 15 criminal charges, including charges of crimes against humanity, crimes against the Jewish people, and membership of an outlawed organization.

zh.s: 艾希曼审判是1961年对纳粹大屠杀主要实施者阿道夫·艾希曼的审判。艾希曼在阿根廷被以色列特工抓获后，被带到以色列受审。他是纳粹党高级成员，曾在党卫军担任中校，主要负责实施“最终解决方案”。
zh.n: 艾希曼审判：阿道夫·艾希曼被以色列法院裁定犯有15项罪名并判处死刑，其中包括危害人类罪、危害犹太人民罪和加入非法组织罪。

en.s: Project Gemini (IPA: ) was the second United States human spaceflight program to fly. It was conducted after the first American crewed space program, Project Mercury, while the Apollo program was still in early development. Gemini was conceived in 1961 and concluded in 1966. The Gemini spacecraft carried a two-astronaut crew. Ten Gemini crews and 16 individual astronauts flew low Earth orbit (LEO) missions during 1965 and 1966.
en.n: Project Gemini: Gemini 6A, crewed by Wally Schirra and Thomas Stafford, is launched from Cape Kennedy, Florida. Four orbits later, it achieves the first space rendezvous, with Gemini 7.

zh.t: 双子星计划：双子星6A号发射并首次与另一艘飞船实现太空交会
zh.s: 双子星计划是美国第二个载人航天计划，接续水星计划实施，当时阿波罗计划仍处于早期研发阶段。该计划于1961年提出，1966年结束。双子星飞船每次搭载两名宇航员；1965至1966年间共有10组双子星乘组、16名宇航员执行近地轨道任务。
zh.n: 双子星计划：瓦利·席拉和托马斯·斯塔福德乘坐双子星6A号从佛罗里达州肯尼迪角发射升空。飞船绕地球飞行4圈后，与双子星7号完成首次太空交会。

en.t: The Silver Bridge collapses, killing 46 people
en.s: The Silver Bridge was an eyebar-chain suspension bridge built in 1928 that carried U.S. Route 35 over the Ohio River, connecting Point Pleasant, West Virginia, and Gallipolis, Ohio. Officially named the Point Pleasant Bridge, it was popularly known as the Silver Bridge for the color of its aluminum paint. On December 15, 1967, the Silver Bridge collapsed amid heavy rush-hour traffic, resulting in the deaths of 46 people, two of whom were never found.

zh.s: 银桥是一座建于1928年的眼杆链式悬索桥，承载美国35号公路跨越俄亥俄河，连接西弗吉尼亚州波因特普莱森特和俄亥俄州加利波利斯。它的正式名称是波因特普莱森特桥，因铝漆颜色而被俗称为银桥。1967年12月15日，银桥在交通高峰时段坍塌，造成46人死亡，其中两人的遗体始终未能找到。

en.s: Venera 7 (Russian: Венера-7, lit. 'Venus 7') was a Soviet spacecraft, part of the Venera series of probes to Venus. When it landed on the Venusian surface on 15 December 1970, it became the first spacecraft to execute a successful soft landing on another planet and the first to transmit data from there back to Earth.

zh.s: 金星7号（俄语：Венера-7）是苏联金星探测器系列中的一艘探测器。它于1970年12月15日在金星表面着陆，成为首个在另一颗行星实现软着陆的航天器，也是首个从那里向地球传回数据的航天器。

en.s: The 1973 Scottish League Cup final was played on 15 December 1973 and was the final of the 28th Scottish League Cup competition. It was contested by Dundee and Celtic. Dundee won the match 1–0, with Gordon Wallace scoring the winning goal.

en.s: The Hsinchu Science Park (HSP; traditional Chinese: 新竹科學園區; simplified Chinese: 新竹科学园区; pinyin: Xīnzhú Kēxué Yuánqū; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Sin-tek Kho-ha̍k Kang-gia̍p Hn̂g-khu) is an industrial park complex that originated as one campus straddling Hsinchu City and Hsinchu County. zh.s: 新竹科学园区最初是一座横跨新竹市和新竹县的园区，之后扩展至苗栗县竹南和铜锣，目前在台湾北部共有6个园区。台湾政府于1980年12月15日设立该园区。

en.s: On December 15, 1981, the Iraqi Shi'a Islamist group al-Dawa carried out a suicide car bombing targeting the Iraqi embassy in Beirut, Lebanon. The explosion leveled the embassy and killed 61 people, including Iraq's ambassador to Lebanon, and injured 110 others. The attack is considered by some to be the first modern suicide bombing, and presaged the 1983 United States embassy bombing and the 1983 Beirut barracks bombing.

zh.t: 1981年伊拉克驻贝鲁特使馆爆炸案
zh.s: 1981年12月15日，伊拉克什叶派伊斯兰组织达瓦党在黎巴嫩贝鲁特发动汽车炸弹自杀式袭击，目标是伊拉克驻当地使馆。爆炸摧毁了使馆，造成61人死亡，包括伊拉克驻黎巴嫩大使，另有110人受伤。有人将此案视为现代自杀式炸弹袭击的开端；它也预示了1983年美国驻贝鲁特使馆爆炸案和贝鲁特军营爆炸案。

en.s: A by-election was held for the British House of Commons constituency of Dudley West on 15 December 1994 following the death of the sitting Conservative Member of Parliament (MP) John Blackburn. The result was a Labour gain from the Conservatives, on one of the largest swings since the Second World War. This was the first significant sign of the changed political climate following the election of Tony Blair as Labour leader, which would eventually lead to Labour's 1997 general election victory. Labour gained nearly 70% of the votes, whereas the Conservative candidate attracted fewer than 20% of the votes.

zh.s: 1994年12月15日，英国下议院达德利西区选区在保守党现任议员约翰·布莱克本去世后举行补选。工党从保守党手中赢得该席位，选票变化幅度是二战以来最大的一次之一。托尼·布莱尔当选工党领袖后，英国政治风向开始出现明显变化；这股变化最终促成工党在1997年大选中获胜。工党得票近70%，保守党候选人得票不到20%。

en.s: The Stu Hart 50th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling supercard produced by the Hart family that took place on December 15, 1995 at the Stampede Corral in Calgary, Alberta. Held in honor of Stu Hart, the event featured Stampede Wrestling alumni as well as talent from World Championship Wrestling and the World Wrestling Federation. It was the first event to feature an interpromotional "dream match" during the Monday Night Wars-era. The proceeds from the event were donated to the Calgary Quest Children's Society. Nine professional wrestling matches, two of which for championships, were featured on the card.

en.s: Operation Falcon Summit (Pashto: Baaz Tsuka) was a Canadian-led operation in the Battle of Panjwaii and, on a larger scale, in the 2001–present War in Afghanistan. NATO forces launched the operation on December 15, 2006 with the intention of expelling Taliban fighters from the Panjawi and Zhari districts of Kandahar. Canadian troops had been fighting with Taliban fighters in the area for several months. Although the operation was under British command, the majority of movements and elements on the ground were Canadians operating from forward operating bases set up in the district during the fighting of Operation Mountain Thrust and Operation Medusa.

zh.s: 猎鹰峰行动（普什图语：Baaz Tsuka）由加拿大主导，是潘杰瓦伊战役及更大范围的阿富汗战争的一部分。北约部队于2006年12月15日发起行动，目标是驱逐坎大哈省潘杰瓦伊和扎里地区的塔利班武装。加拿大军队此前已在当地与塔利班交战数月。行动由英国指挥，但地面部队的大多数调动和行动由加拿大军队执行，他们从前线作战基地出发；这些基地是在此前的“山地突击行动”和“美杜莎行动”期间设立的。

en.s: TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs (2013) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE, which took place on December 15, 2013, at the Toyota Center in Houston.
